note: Failures the app has today that this build does not fix, because nothing in src/ changes. Each prints on every run and does not fail the run. A known failure that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a fix is never merged without its entry coming off this list.

failures.shows: The page header still reads Staff Management, Cases, Forms or Settings, and the content area below it is 0 characters. No message, no redirect, nothing to click.
failures.why: The nav hides these four items from a supervisor, but the render switch at src/App.js:545, 546, 561 and 562 gates on isAdmin with no else branch, so a supervisor who reaches the hash directly gets the header over an empty body.

failures.shows: Tapping the filed-report notice in the bell sets the hash to forms/reports/<id> and lands the supervisor on the empty Forms page. The case notice does the same on the empty Cases page.
failures.why: NotificationPanel.openRow at src/App.js:2675 routes a notice by its subject and its link without checking whether the person can open the page it names, and Forms and Cases are admin-only at src/App.js:561 and src/App.js:546.

failures.shows: A four-letter certification framework acronym reaches eight places a person reads: two window field labels on the Sites page, a field label and a CSV export column on the Service Catalog, a CSV export column and a field label and a section heading in Inspections, and the green banner over the PDF Access Log.
failures.why: CLAUDE.md says the acronym must never appear in any screen, label or export that staff or clients see. These eight were written before that rule and were never swept.
failures.where: src/App.js:1979, src/App.js:1994, src/App.js:4051, src/App.js:4076, src/App.js:5974, src/App.js:6279, src/App.js:6451, src/App.js:8398

failures.shows: A supervisor granted the manage permissions capability opens Settings and gets a 0 character body. The capability the app describes as the way to let someone else open that screen does not let them open it.
failures.why: The Settings page is gated on isAdmin in the render switch at src/App.js:562, and the capability is never consulted there. The copy at src/App.js:6941 says an admin can grant the capability to let someone else open this screen, which is not true today.

failures.shows: The Roles and Permissions tab shows the per-person editor. The reference matrix, its notes and its Export PDF are never drawn, so one of the dashboard's exports cannot be reached from any screen.
failures.why: PermissionsMatrixPanel is defined at src/App.js:6781 and no tab mounts it. The permissions tab renders PermissionsEditorPanel at src/App.js:7112 instead.

failures.shows: Top supplies by cost, on the supply report, and Lowest-scoring items, on the inspection report, both draw NaN down the side where the supply and item names belong. One NaN per bar. A manager reading either panel cannot tell which supply or which item a bar is.
failures.why: BarChartW sets a y axis formatter of Math.round(v) plus a suffix. With horizontal turned on the axes swap, so the category names arrive at that formatter and Math.round of a name is NaN. The fix is to leave the formatter off when horizontal is set.
